blind.description: A dark wooden rectangular tray stand or altar table holding sand and multiple unlit pillar candles. The frame has four square carved wooden legs, a lower wooden shelf, and a raised perimeter rim around the top tray. The tray is filled with beige sand, out of which several thick pale yellowish-tan wax candles of varying heights emerge, each with a small black wick at the top. Surfaces are clean, stylized, and solid, with no flames or glowing elements.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden frame enclosing a sandy beige basin with roughly ten pale round candle tops dotted across it, with the lower shelf and feet slightly visible around the edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 2.8 feet tall (roughly waist-high or lower, around 45% the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3 feet wide.
